content_data.project_title: Content Strategy & Automation Blueprint for Enhanced Travel Customer Journeys
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive proposal for developing and implementing an automated content strategy designed to optimize customer engagement and conversion across the travel industry's North American market.
content_data.timeline: Over a 4-month period, with initial strategy development in month 1-2 and automation integration in month 3-4.
objectives: Streamline content creation and distribution processes using automation tools.
deliverables: Content automation workflow diagrams and recommended tool stack
Pilot program content assets for a selected travel segment
Detailed automated content strategy document (including journey mapping and content pillars)
